boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source:
Upon expiring the corpselight implodes, pulling in all foes towards its center and dealing %0.2f cold damage.
		The damage is increased by +10%% per stack.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

		#PURPLE#Learning this spell will make Corpselight cost two souls to use instead of one.
entries.target:
你的鬼火消失时会发生爆炸，将所有敌人拖向中心位置，并造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害。
		鬼火每叠加一层，伤害增加 10%%。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

		#PURPLE#学习这一技能会把你阴燃鬼火消耗的灵魂数量从 1 增加到 2。

entries.source: As you walk into the area you notice a huge thunderstorm over your head. Beware!
entries.target: 当你进入这个区域时，你感觉到一股暴风雨在你的头顶盘旋。小心！

entries.source: A large sluglike creature that moves slowly, leaving a trail of acid in its wake.  Its head has strangely humanoid features.
entries.target: 一只长的类似蛞蝓的生物，当它缓慢经过时，会留下一滩酸性的踪迹。它的头部有着奇怪的人类特征。

entries.source: You are being observed too closely to enter Stealth!
entries.target: 你不能在周围有怪物注视你的情况下潜行！

entries.source:
You recall the age long gone where necromancers had free reign over the world.
		Increases all saves by %d, confusion and teleport resistances by %d%%.
		At level 5 any time you cross the 1 life threshold you become invulnerable for 1 turns.
entries.target:
你回忆起久远的黄金时代，死灵法师自由支配这个世界。
		获得 %d 全体豁免，%d%% 混乱和传送抗性。
		技能等级 5 时，每当你穿越 1 生命值的界线，无敌 1 回合。

entries.source:
You find a tattered page scrap. Perhaps this is part of a diary entry.
"...writing this in a tree and he's at the bottom of it. Waiting. His club is the size of a tall dwarf. Don't think I'm going to make it..."

Alongside the note is a part of a plan of the region.
entries.target:
你找到了一片破烂的纸页残片。也许这是某篇日记的一部分。
“……我正在树上写这些，而他就在树下等着。他的棍棒足有一个高个矮人那么大。我恐怕活不下去了……”

字条旁边还有一张区域地图的残片。

entries.source: The target is rampaging! (+%d%% movement speed, +%d%% attack speed, +%d%% mind speed
entries.target: 目标进入暴走状态！(+%d%% 移动速度，+%d%% 攻击速度，+%d%% 精神速度

entries.source: [Alter the appearance of your facial features]
An animated corpse in mummy wrappings, both very well preserved.
entries.target: 一具缠绕着裹尸布的活化尸体，尸身与裹尸布均保存完好。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Damage resistance: all#LAST#
All damage you receive, through any means, is decreased by this percentage.
This stacks (multiplicatively) with individual damage type resistances up to their respective caps.
(So 20% resistance: All + 50% resistance: Fire = 60% total resistance to Fire.)
entries.target:
#GOLD#伤害抗性：全体#LAST#
所有类型任何方式对你造成的伤害按此值减免。
可以与独立类型的伤害减免效果乘法叠加，但不能超过对应的抗性上限。
因此（20%伤害抗性：全体+50%伤害抗性：火=60%火焰伤害抗性）

entries.source:
Your glyphs are imbued with celestial fury; they last %d turns longer and when triggered they will deal damage.
		#ffd700#Glyph of Sunlight#LAST#:  Deals %0.2f light damage.
		#7f7f7f#Glyph of Moonlight#LAST#:  Deals %0.2f darkness damage.
		#9D9DC9#Glyph of Twilight#LAST#:  Deals %0.2f light and %0.2f darkness damage.
entries.target:
你的圣印被注入了来自天空的怒火。
		它们的持续时间延长 %d 回合，并在触发时造成额外伤害。
		#ffd700#日光圣印#LAST#：造成 %0.2f 光系伤害。
		#7f7f7f#月光圣印#LAST#：造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害。
		#9D9DC9#暮光圣印#LAST#：造成 %0.2f 光系和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。

entries.source: However annoying this will be for you to gather, I promise that the reek it produces in my lab will prove even more annoying.
entries.target: 不管采集它会让你多么恼火，我保证它在我实验室里散发的恶臭会更令人受不了。

entries.source: You have expended the power of your Radiance temporarily reducing its radius to 1.
entries.target: 你身边的光亮变得暗淡了，光照半径降低到1码。

entries.source: The knowledge of poisons and how to apply them to 'good' effects.
entries.target: 关于毒物的知识，以及如何用它们取得“良好”的效果。

entries.source: Paladin Aeryn told me that you could help me. I need to get to Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 太阳骑士艾琳跟我说你能帮助我，我想去马基·埃亚尔。

entries.source: They can harness the blight of evil, crushing souls, stealing life force to replenish themselves.
entries.target: 他们驾驭邪恶的枯萎术，粉碎灵魂，偷取生命力量来治疗自己。

entries.source: This elf is a companion of Berethh. He's dressed in light armor and wields a sword.
entries.target: 这个精灵战士是贝里斯的同伴。他身穿皮甲，手拿长剑。

entries.source:
Attack with your offhand weapon for %d%% damage. If the attack hits, the target is stunned for %d turns, and you hit it with your mainhand weapon doing %d%% damage.
		The stun chance increases with your Accuracy.
entries.target:
用副手武器造成 %d%% 伤害。
		如果攻击命中，目标将会被震慑 %d 回合并且你会使用主武器对目标造成 %d%% 伤害。
		震慑概率受命中加成。

entries.source: This small wooden ring has a single green stem wrapped around it. Thin leaves still seem to be growing from it.
entries.target: 这枚小巧的戒指上缠绕着一根藤蔓，藤蔓似乎仍然在不断的吐出新叶。

entries.source: The remaining lumberjacks collect some gold to thank you (%0.2f).
entries.target: 剩余的伐木工人收集了一些黄金来谢谢你(%0.2f)。

entries.source: Torques are made by powerful psionics to store psionic powers.
entries.target: 项圈由强大的灵能者制造，用来储存灵能。

entries.source:
While this talent is sustained, you anticipate deadly attacks against you.
		Any time you would lose more than %d%% of your maximum life in a single hit, you instead duck out of the way and assume a defensive posture.
		This reduces the triggering damage and all further damage in the same turn by %d%%.
		You need %0.1f Stamina and an adjacent open tile to perform this feat (though it does not cause you to move).
entries.target:
当这个技能被激活的时候，你能够预见到致命的伤害。
		每当单次攻击将使你损失超过最大生命值的 %d%% 时，你会闪身躲避并摆出防御姿势。
		这个技能降低本次伤害和接下来本回合的所有伤害 %d%%。
		你需要 %0.1f 体力和相邻的无人空地来触发技能效果（尽管你不会因为躲避而移动）。

entries.source: Learn to channel your mental power through mindstars, forming powerful psionic blades.
entries.target: 学会将你的精神能量灌注于灵晶中，产生心灵利刃。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN##Source# gains %d%%%% of a turn from Ancestral Life.#LAST#
#Target#'s acid damage is no longer so potent.

Activate the taint to purge your body of physical afflictions for %d turns.
			Each turn the purge will attempt to cleanse 1 physical debuff from you, and if one is removed, increase its duration by 1.
entries.target:
激活这个印记，清除你身上的物理负面效果，持续 %d 回合。
			每一回合，这个印记将会尝试从你的身上解除一个物理负面效果。
			如果它解除了一个负面效果，它的持续时间会增加 1 回合。

entries.source: Archers are fast and deadly, and with pinning shots can render their foes helpless as they swiftly dispatch them.
entries.target: 弓箭手行动迅捷而致命，他们可以使用定身射击使敌人无力反抗，然后迅速解决他们。

entries.source: The noxious fumes of the caldera are slowly affecting you...
entries.target: 火山的毒烟正在渐渐影响你…

entries.source: It is silenced for the next %d turn(s), preventing it from casting spells and using some vocal talents.
entries.target: 目标还会被沉默 %d 回合，无法施放法术或使用部分发声类技能。

entries.source: All damage you do also trigget a manaburn for %d%% of the damage done.
entries.target: 你造成的所有伤害会触发一次伤害值 %d%% 的法力燃烧。

entries.source: The target is the epicenter of a terrible arcane storm, providing +%d%% arcane resistance.
entries.target: 目标处于巨大奥术风暴的中心，提供 +%d%% 奥术抗性。

entries.source:
Fire an arrow for %d%% weapon damage. When the arrow reaches its destination or hits a target it will draw in all other targets in a radius of %d and inflict %0.2f physical damage.
		Each target moved beyond the first increases the damage %0.2f (up to %0.2f bonus damage).
		Targets take reduced damage the further they are from the epicenter (20%% less per tile).
		The additional damage scales with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
发射一支箭，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。当箭矢到达目的地或命中目标时，会牵引半径 %d 内的所有其他目标，并造成 %0.2f 物理伤害。
		从第二个被移动的目标起，每多移动一个目标，伤害增加 %0.2f（额外伤害上限为 %0.2f）。
		目标距中心点越远，受到的伤害越低（每格降低 20%%）。
		额外伤害受法术强度加成。
